about: Classic Cloud route guard (tests/test_classic_cloud_routes.py). NEXT code (the paths below) adds no call to classic Cloud: /api/vm, /api/runs, or cmux.com / cmux-staging.vercel.app as the Cloud API base; new Cloud work goes to cmux-platform. Each entry is a call NEXT still makes: {file, pattern, count: exact number of matches, reason}. The list only shrinks: removing a call means lowering its count (drop the entry at 0). A new entry or a raised count needs a reason starting "keep: " that says why (a move from Swift to Rust, say); existing calls are "debt: ".
